description: Surface Optimization of the (100) Surface of Al (Cubic, Fm-3m) and Surface Energy Calculation
user_prompt: Optimize the (100) surface of aluminum Al (cubic, Fm-3m) and calculate the surface energy. Report the final surface energy in J/m^2.

method.modeling: fcc Al (Fm-3m) (100) surface; symmetric slab (>= 6-7 layers), vacuum >= 15 A, surface fully relaxed.
method.rationale: Value 0.86 J/m^2 is the relaxed Al(100) PBE surface energy from Singh-Miller & Marzari 2009 (plane-wave PBE, Quantum ESPRESSO; their Table III, alongside Al(111)=0.67 and Al(110)=0.93). PBE substantially underestimates surface energy versus the experimental ~1.14 J/m^2 (Tyson & Miller 1977), so the case is graded against the PBE value, not experiment. Metallic Al requires Methfessel-Paxton smearing. Tolerance +/-0.20 J/m^2 (absolute) covers inter-setup PBE scatter (slab thickness, k-mesh, pseudopotential); larger deviations usually signal an unconverged slab.
